name: MaterialDeliveryLogistics
tagline: Book site delivery slots, allocate gates and cranes, check vehicles in and stop clashes before the lorry arrives.
description: A complete construction site delivery app for Power Apps and Power Pages: today's arrivals and KPIs, a slot planner by gate or crane/hoist with restricted traffic-management windows and drag-and-drop, clash detection, gate check-in with punctuality, rejected loads and no-shows, and supplier delivery performance.
features: Gate capacity and crane/hoist clash detection
Restricted windows, delivery hours and notice period
Rejected loads with reasons, no-shows, rebooking
Bulk confirm / reschedule / cancel with undo
